about.title: About UniDL · Open-source acknowledgements
about.intro: UniDL is built on open-source software. Thank you to every maintainer and contributor whose work makes this project possible.
about.license_note: This summary is for acknowledgement. The project files and each upstream project contain the complete licence terms and notices.
update.title: UniDL update
update.remote_reserved: Remote update checking is reserved for a future signed release service; this build makes no network request.
update.no_remote_check: No remote update was checked. The release notes below describe this build.
update.note.downloader: Returning from a paused or active download no longer crashes the TUI; detached log callbacks are ignored safely.
update.note.service_views: The home version dialog now reports UniDL v2.0.1 and shows these maintenance notes.
update.note.media_types: The PyPI package and command-line version now use the 2.0.1 release metadata.
update.note.documentation: The MIT license and third-party notices are included in the source and wheel distributions.

settings.title: Settings
settings.group.download_help: These choices control what UniDL does after resolving a title, and native transfer options that are not covered by a service's Tracks and output settings. They do not change a service's manifest or track selection.
settings.group.interface_help: Theme and language apply immediately. Debug mode adds detail and enables the explicit service-code reload shortcut.

setting.download_manager.help: Choose what happens after a title is resolved, native transfer options that are not per-service track settings, whether live streams are recorded, whether DRM waits for the final selected tracks, and whether batch downloads ask for confirmation.
setting.fetch_chapters.help: When enabled, services may request and parse optional chapter metadata. When disabled, chapter endpoints and optional chapter fields are skipped. A chapter failure is auxiliary and never stops playback, DRM, downloading or final muxing. This controls acquisition globally; the per-service 'Embed chapters in the final file' setting controls only container muxing.
setting.after_resolve.help: Downloading and saving the command both need a licence, and both leave the command file and any keys behind. Listing asks for nothing. An export is the licence written down.
setting.after_resolve.option.command: Don't download, just save the command
setting.after_resolve.option.list: Just list the tracks, ask for no keys
setting.after_resolve.option.export: Save an export file: the manifest, the tracks and the keys
setting.live_record.help: Off, a live channel is resolved and its command saved without recording. On, UniDL records for as long as the service's live recording length says.
setting.license_after_tracks.help: Compatibility mode for services whose licence init data is only available on selected media playlists. Off keeps full-manifest inventory licensing.
setting.theme.help: Takes effect immediately and repaints the current screen.
setting.interface_locale.help: Language of UniDL's own labels, prompts and settings. Service names, titles, URLs and API locales are not translated. Follow the system reads LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, then LANG.
setting.interface_manager.help: Choose the colour theme, interface language and diagnostic logging. Debug mode also enables the explicit service-code reload shortcut; it never watches files.
setting.resource_manager.help: Manage app-wide DRM/CDM choices, local and remote CDM devices, and key-vault backends in one place.
setting.storage_manager.help: Manage output folders and file-name templates in one place. Sensitive runtime paths are shown there for reference but remain read-only.
setting.proxy_manager.help: Choose the app-wide route, decide whether segment downloads use it, and manage named proxy endpoints and supported VPN proxy providers.
setting.justwatch_manager.help: Set the one catalogue used to find titles and the separate list of countries checked for streaming availability.
setting.debug.help: Verbose logging, keeps temp files, writes stream metadata and a session log. It also enables the explicit Ctrl+R service-code reload on the main screen.
setting.confirm_batch.help: Ask once before processing a multi-episode selection.
setting.retries.help: How many times a failed segment is retried before the track fails.
setting.http_timeout.help: Timeout for each native downloader HTTP request.
setting.max_speed.help: Cap segment download speed, e.g. 15M, 100K, 2Mbps. Empty means unlimited.
setting.muxer.help: Which tool writes the final container. Auto prefers mkvmerge for MKV when it recognises the inputs. Per-service Container still chooses mkv vs mp4.
setting.segment_downloader.help: The native engine's segment backend. aria2c is used only when chosen and installed.
setting.resume_parts.help: On, verified parts in tmp are reused after a pause or a retry. Off starts every track from scratch.
setting.check_segments_count.help: Fail a track when the number of downloaded parts does not match the manifest.
setting.keep_temp.help: Keep segment caches after a successful download. Debug mode also keeps them.
setting.delete_temp_after_done.help: Remove temporary segment directories when a title finishes successfully.
setting.auto_subtitle_fix.help: De-duplicate and tidy text cues while converting subtitles.
setting.live_real_time_merge.help: Append live segments to the output as they arrive instead of waiting until stop.
setting.live_keep_segments.help: Keep per-segment live files in tmp after recording.
setting.live_pipe_mux.help: Mux live audio/video after recording. Ignored for audio-only titles.
setting.track_mode.help: Whether to show the track picker or select silently using these rules.
setting.audio_langs.help: Comma separated, e.g. en,es. Empty = best only.
setting.sub_langs.help: Comma separated, 'all', or empty to skip.
setting.drop_video.help: Regex. Keeps trick-play and thumbnail ladders out of quality selection without matching those letters inside an ordinary title.
setting.embed_chapters: Embed chapters in the final file
setting.embed_chapters.help: When the service provides chapter metadata, write it into the final MKV/MP4 container. Turning this off keeps chapters in the report, saved command metadata and export, but does not mux them into media.
setting.embed_lyrics: Embed lyrics in the final audio file
setting.embed_lyrics.help: Write a plain-text lyrics tag into compatible audio files. Turning this off retains timed lyrics for display and export.
setting.release_template: What is added after the name
setting.audio_format.option.source: Keep the original, do not re-encode

storage.help.output: Edit ordinary output locations. Existing files are never moved; an empty value returns to the configured default.
storage.help.naming: Templates keep their existing settings keys. The preview uses a sample 1080p Dolby Vision release.

resource.title: DRM & vaults
resource.help.cdm: Local CDM files stay on disk; remote endpoints can be added, edited, disabled or removed here. Service-specific CDM choices remain in that service's Settings.
resource.help.vault: A disabled vault stays configured but is never used. Vault policy controls lookup, writes and home search.

resource.cdm_help: Required: name, server device name, address and secret. Optional values are used to verify the server when it opens a CDM session.
resource.vault_help: Required: name, backend type, address and token. Search support is only valid for an HTTP JSON vault that declares supported service IDs.

proxy.title: Proxy & VPN
proxy.help.routing: The route applies to UniDL's API, manifests and licences. Segment routing is independent.
proxy.help.endpoints: Legacy `proxies:` names remain valid. A list is a random endpoint pool; name2 pins its second entry.
proxy.help.providers: Provider queries look like provider:region. ExpressVPN uses device authorization; NordVPN, Surfshark and Windscribe use manual-setup service credentials.
proxy.route.title: Default proxy route
proxy.route.help: Leave empty for a direct connection. Use a URI, a saved endpoint name, or a provider query such as expressvpn:us, nordvpn:us, surfshark:gb or windscribe:ca:toronto.
proxy.named.title: Named proxy endpoint
proxy.named.help: Name it for the Proxy row or a service setting. Multiple URLs are tried as a random pool; separate them with commas. Credentials stay in unidl.yaml.
proxy.field.name: Name
proxy.need_named: A name and at least one proxy URI are required
proxy.provider.title: {label} provider
proxy.provider.help: Use service credentials from the provider's manual setup page, not the normal account email. The region query is resolved to an HTTPS proxy only.
proxy.need_creds: Service username and password are required
proxy.express.title: ExpressVPN provider
proxy.express.help: Save the optional aliases, then select ExpressVPN and press l to authorize. OAuth tokens are stored under paths.tokens/vpn, never in this form.
proxy.placeholder.account_json: path to an exported ExpressVPN account JSON

proxy.add_provider_help: These providers return an HTTPS proxy endpoint and do not alter system networking.

ready.title: Readiness
setting.drm_system.help: Which CDM to use when a service offers a choice. Each system needs its own library and its own device file; one that is not installed says so.
setting.local_vault.help: On, a title whose key IDs are all already in the local vault is served from there and no licence request is made. Off, every title goes through a real licence exchange. Keys are still written to selected local write targets either way.
setting.remote_vault.help: The same thing for vaults configured under key_vaults that live on a server. Off by default because it is a network call. Unlike the local switch, this one governs writes as well as reads.
setting.vault_read_targets.help: Choose one or more configured vaults. Empty means all vaults in the local/remote categories enabled above; use the explicit empty selection to disable every destination.
setting.vault_search_targets.help: Choose local and explicitly searchable remote vaults. Local keys appear immediately; remote keys are queried only after you select Search remote vault from the results.
setting.vault_write_targets.help: Choose one or more writable vaults for licence, rotation and manual keys. Empty means all writable configured vaults.
setting.proxy.help: Empty means direct. A value is either a name from the proxies section of unidl.yaml or a full URI.
setting.proxy_downloads.help: Only read when a proxy is set. On, segment downloads use it too. Off, UniDL fetches segments directly.
setting.download_dir.help: Downloads and live recordings both land here. Empty means the folder configured in unidl.yaml.
setting.name_template_episode.help: The shape of an episode's name. The resolution, platform and tag are added afterwards by the release template.
setting.name_template_movie.help: The same fields, for something with no episode number.
setting.release_template.help: What is added after the title. Audio and video fields come from the tracks finally selected for download.
setting.release_tag.help: What goes after the dash at the end of a file name. Left off entirely when empty.
setting.justwatch_search_region.help: Whose catalogue the title list comes from - one ISO country code.
setting.justwatch_regions.help: Which regions are asked who carries a title, in order. Comma separated ISO country codes.
setting.cdm_rules.help: Which device answers, decided by the resolution being taken. Empty means one device for everything.
setting.audio_format.help: Applies to audio-only titles - radio, podcasts - and is ignored for anything with a picture.
setting.cdm_rule_condition: Use a device when the resolution is
setting.cdm_rule_condition.help: The resolution being taken, read the same way the file name is - so a rule about 1080p covers exactly the titles named 1080p.
justwatch.not_in_regions: not available in any of these regions
justwatch.status_summary: {carried} of {total} regions have it · {openable} offer(s) open in a service
justwatch.disc_sale: {provider} sells a disc, not a stream
justwatch.no_search: {name} has no search; paste the URL once you have it
